description: Low-poly tree in three styles: round (a cluster of faceted blobs), conifer (stacked cones) and poplar (a tall narrow crown). Pivot at the base of the trunk. Pieces: tree_trunk (bark), tree_canopy (foliage, or foliage_dark for conifers). Every piece is closed.

params.height: =style == 'conifer' ? height * 0.3 : style == 'poplar' ? height * 0.45 : Math.max(height * 0.3, height - canopy_radius * 0.95)
center: =(style == 'conifer' ? height * 0.3 : style == 'poplar' ? height * 0.45 : Math.max(height * 0.3, height - canopy_radius * 0.95)) / 2

crown_pts.note: one point per crown part: P, scale, orient, tint (cones stand on their point, blobs are centred on it)

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) || 1 : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
